method: manually transcribed from public Github Status incident notices, not inferred from local collector failures

incidents.causal_claim: Github reports some Actions did not start when queued events expired; a Kafka broker degradation had begun Nov 7. This is external direct evidence of potential dropped scheduled runs, not confirmed matching individual AIBA run IDs.
Provider confirmed degraded availability of GitHub Actions and related services.
Provider confirmed Actions backlog and multi-product degradation.
Provider confirmed Webhooks timeouts; not independently known to affect scheduled AIBA collectors.

alternative_external_incident.reported_impact: Microsoft 365 Outlook Teams and downstream connectors; no evidence yet of direct impact on AIBA Github Actions collection.

interpretation: External incidents overlap measured historical collection-gap dates. Temporal coincidence does not establish that each missed start was caused by GitHub. The scheduling diagnosis should be reassessed in a healthy postincident period before adopting a paid scheduler.
